_comment: Hand-maintained. Everything the Notion sync can't produce on its own.
drop     remove a Notion row from the map, keyed by its Notion page id
override replace fields on a Notion-derived pin (same key), for when the Notion
value is awkward on a pin label and you'd rather not edit Notion
booked   Notion page ids that are actually reserved — draws the ⭐ and the booked count
places   standalone pins appended after the synced ones (hotels, extra branches,
anything not in Notion at all)
Notion page ids are the `id` field in data/places.notion.json.
A drop/override/booked entry pointing at a row that no longer exists is reported by
the build as stale rather than failing it.
